title: Form Template Step
description: A logical grouping of fields rendered as a single page or section in a multi-step form. Steps are part of the FormTemplate version; changes to a step's title, description, or contained fields produce a new template version.

title.description: Display title shown to the user (e.g., 'Institutional Information').

description.description: Instructions shown at the top of the page/section.

fields.description: Ordered list of field slots within this step. Each slot binds a JSON pointer in the schema to a UI definition.
